fontSize.label: Size
fontSize.previewTitle: Ready to check off today's to-dos?
fontSize.previewDescription: The size you pick applies across the app right away

aiDataSharing.label: AI data sharing
aiDataSharing.description: What you type or say goes to Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI for processing. Apple or Google speech recognition may turn speech into text. Audio files aren't sent to Aido's servers.
aiDataSharing.descriptionGoogleOnly: AI features send what you enter to Google Gemini for processing.
aiDataSharing.withdrawDescription: AI features will stop working. Your to-dos stay.
aiDataSharing.declinedStatus: Off. Turn it on to use it again.
aiDataSharing.undecidedStatus: We'll ask the first time you use an AI feature.

voiceStorage.description: Audio files aren't sent to Aido's servers. Voice notes and their audio are deleted automatically after 30 days.
voiceStorage.emptyDescription: Recordings from your voice notes appear here, so you can check their size and delete them.
voiceStorage.removeDescription: The text and summary stay. Only the audio is deleted, so you can't play it back. This can't be undone.
